title: A-RSI: Adaptive Task Refresh for Zero-Data Multimodal Self-Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2610.38568v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recursive self-improvement requires models not only to acquire useful training experience, but also to decide when their current experience has ceased to be useful. Existing methods often focus on what experience to generate next, while paying less attention to when fresh experience should be introduced. Many also construct training targets through self-consistency or majority voting, making supervision depend on the model's own uncertain predictions. We address these two questions separately: training dynamics determine when to acquire new experience, while the answers to new tasks remain independently checkable. A-RSI monitors reward variation and accuracy in training logs to refresh a task pool when its learning signal declines, without consulting validation or test scores. A static library of model-authored programs produces multimodal questions and derives their reference answers; we specify the task-generation contract, automatical

translated_title: A-RSI：面向零数据多模态自我改进的自适应任务刷新
translated_abstract: 递归自我改进要求模型不仅能够获取有用的训练经验，还需判断当前经验何时已不再有用。现有方法通常关注下一步生成什么经验，而较少关注何时应引入新鲜经验；许多方法还通过自一致性或多数投票构建训练目标，使得监督信号依赖于模型自身的不确定预测。我们将这两个问题分开处理：训练动态决定何时获取新经验，而新任务的答案仍然可以被独立验证。A-RSI 监控训练日志中的奖励变化与准确率，当学习信号下降时刷新任务池，且无需查阅验证集或测试集分数。一个由模型编写程序构成的静态库用于生成多模态问题并推导其参考答案；我们规定了任务生成契约，自动化……
tldr: A-RSI 通过监控训练日志中的奖励变化与准确率在学习信号衰退时自适应刷新任务池，并利用模型编写程序的静态库生成多模态问题及可独立验证的参考答案，从而实现零数据的多模态递归自我改进。
en_tdlr: A-RSI adaptively refreshes its task pool by monitoring reward variation and accuracy in training logs, while a static library of model-authored programs generates multimodal questions with independently verifiable reference answers, enabling zero-data multimodal recursive self-improvement.
